title: Deep Space Aquarium Defense
description: Kira pilots a spacecraft powered by an ion drive through a surreal deep-space aquarium where giant BarramundiFish roam as hostile entities. The player must steer Kira's ship to dodge incoming fish, activate the ion drive to boost away, and collect energy orbs to survive 60 seconds.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a space aquarium defense game. Load three GLB assets using GLTFLoader: BarramundiFish.glb (enemy), kira.glb (player character), and PrimaryIonDrive.glb (engine attachment). Scene setup: dark space background with a subtle starfield created from 500 small white sphere particles. Add ambient light intensity 0.4 and a blue-tinted directional light intensity 0.8 from above. Place a semi-transparent blue-green bounding box (40x40x40 units) as the aquarium arena boundary. Player setup: attach the PrimaryIonDrive model behind the kira model as a single player ship, scaled appropriately, starting at origin. Camera follows the player from behind in third-person at offset (0, 5, -12). Enemies: spawn 5 BarramundiFish at random positions along arena edges, scaled 3x, each slowly homing toward the player with sinusoidal swimming motion on the Y axis. Interactions requiring validation: (1) WASD keys move the player ship on the XZ plane with clamping inside the arena, validate position stays in bounds. (2) Spacebar activates ion drive boost doubling speed for 2 seconds with a 5-second cooldown, validate cooldown timer. (3) When boost activates, add a glowing particle trail behind the ion drive using 20 small orange spheres that fade out. (4) Collision detection between player and fish using bounding sphere checks with radius validation. (5) On collision, flash screen red, decrement health from 3, validate health never goes below 0. (6) Every 10 seconds spawn a rotating green energy orb at a random position; collecting it restores 1 health, validate max health cap of 3. (7) Display an HTML overlay HUD showing health hearts, boost cooldown bar, elapsed time, and score. (8) Score increments by 1 each second survived. Game ends at 0 health showing game-over screen with final score and a restart button. Fish that leave bounds respawn at a random edge. Ensure all models load before starting the game loop with a loading screen.
